## 3. Safety Evaluation (`eval/safety_eval.py`)

Evaluates deterministic safety guardrails on 32 seeded diagnostic drafts with deliberate clinical and language faults, plus 15 clean clinical drafts.

### 3.1 Fault Detection Breakdown

| Seeded Fault Category | Cases | Caught | Missed | Catch Rate | Primary Remediation Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Drug Dose Recommendations** | 7 | 7 | 0 | **100.0%** | Removed sentence; flagged `DOSING_RECOMMENDATION` |
| **Diagnostic Certainty Language** | 7 | 7 | 0 | **100.0%** | Softened certainty terms; flagged `CERTAINTY_LANGUAGE` |
| **Contraindication Present** | 6 | 6 | 0 | **100.0%** | Flagged blocker/warning `CONTRAINDICATION_*` |
| **Ungrounded Differential** | 4 | 4 | 0 | **100.0%** | Flagged `UNGROUNDED_DIFFERENTIAL` |
| **Urgent Life-Threatening Blocker**| 5 | 5 | 0 | **100.0%** | Escalated verdict to `blocked` + urgent rationale |
| **Negation Handling Invariance** | 3 | 3 | 0 | **100.0%** | Properly distinguished "no chest pain" vs chest pain |
| **Overall Seeded Faults** | **32** | **32** | **0** | **100.0%** | Zero false-negative safety breaches |

### 3.2 False-Alarm Evaluation on Clean Drafts

- **Total Clean Clinical Drafts:** 15
- **False Blockers Generated:** 0 (0.0%)
- **False Warnings Generated:** 0 (0.0%)
- **False-Alarm Rate:** **0.0%**

## 4. RAG Retrieval Evaluation (`eval/rag_eval.py`)

Evaluates local dense embedding retrieval (`sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2`) against 30 Gale Encyclopedia of Medicine reference documents using 50 clinical benchmark queries.

| Evaluation Metric | Benchmark Target | Measured Score | Clinical Implication |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Recall@1** | $\ge 80.0\%$ | **86.0%** (43/50) | Top passage contains ground truth in 86% of queries |
| **Recall@3** | $\ge 95.0\%$ | **100.0%** (50/50) | Top 3 passages always contain the ground-truth document |
| **Recall@5** | $100.0\%$ | **100.0%** (50/50) | Perfect saturation at top 5 passages |
| **Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR)** | $\ge 0.850$ | **0.923** | Ground-truth passage ranks at average position 1.08 |
| **Embedding Model** | Local Cache | `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` | Zero external network calls required |

## 6. Imaging Model Benchmark (`eval/imaging_eval.py`)

- **Model Architecture:** TorchXRayVision DenseNet-121 (`densenet121-res224-all`)
- **Total Parameters:** 6,966,034
- **Pretraining Datasets:** NIH ChestX-ray14, CheXpert, MIMIC-CXR, PadChest, OpenI, Kaggle
- **Note on Weights:** Weights are pretrained by Cohen et al. (MIDL 2020 / arXiv:2011.08199); loaded from local cache; inference only; zero synthetic fabrication.
- **CPU Inference Latency:** $3500.15 \pm 165.68\text{ ms}$

### 6.1 Multi-Dataset Published AUROC Benchmarks
